description: This file defines an interface for a PSR-17 factory within the Slim Framework, specifying methods for obtaining and checking the availability of various HTTP message factories and request creators.

classes.name: Psr17FactoryInterface
classes.description: Defines static methods for retrieving and checking availability of PSR-17 message factories and request creators.

methods.name: getResponseFactory
methods.description: Returns an instance of ResponseFactoryInterface or throws RuntimeException if unavailable.

methods.name: getStreamFactory
methods.description: Returns an instance of StreamFactoryInterface or throws RuntimeException if unavailable.

methods.name: getServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Returns an instance of ServerRequestCreatorInterface or throws RuntimeException if unavailable.

methods.name: isResponseFactoryAvailable
methods.description: Returns true if the PSR-17 ResponseFactory is available.

methods.name: isStreamFactoryAvailable
methods.description: Returns true if the PSR-17 StreamFactory is available.

methods.name: isServerRequestCreatorAvailable
methods.description: Returns true if the ServerRequest creator is available.
